Suggest replacing the `--regex` paragraph with:

The --regex flag (-r) treats each argument as a regular expression and deletes every topic whose full name matches any of them. rpk wraps each expression in ^ and $, so it must match the whole name.

Regex mode never deletes internal topics: the topics Redpanda reports as internal, which 'rpk topic list' shows only with -i. To delete an internal topic, name it exactly, without -r.
